lines: | **`benchmark/2026-10-02-upstream-copy-map/`** | **What to copy from upstream A2OH/westlake-harness (framework 68, 154/201 + 82/100 draw): only 51/166 of our keys match by package; 13 they draw / we don't; 7 walls ranked (white window 17 = our N11 architecture; Flutter 6; ICU libicu_jni null 2 = same wall, fix 03678da zero-init locals; settings provider not connected in 161/165 hilogs = 1c883ad). 26 of 28 ledger fixed_in commits are local in vm-copies/westlake-current (a2hlab/westlake origin/main, corpus2-fixes), not only in the inaccessible public repo.** |
